question: Which race has the shortest actual finishing time? Please give the name and year.
evidence: shortest actual finishing time refers to Min(milliseconds) except milliseconds = null;
clarification: Ignore rows where milliseconds is missing.
gold: SELECT T1.name, T1.year FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId ORDER BY T2.milliseconds LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.name, T1.year FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T2.milliseconds LIMIT 1

d.request: Which race has the shortest actual finishing time, excluding rows where milliseconds is missing? Give the race name and year.
d.sql: SELECT r.name, r.year FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE res.position = 1 AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY res.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;

c.sql: SELECT races.name, races.year FROM races JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId WHERE results.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY results.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1;

b.request: Which race has the lowest non-NULL `results.milliseconds` value? Return its name and year
b.sql: SELECT races.name, races.year FROM results JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId WHERE results.milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY results.milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1
